title: Alpha Multiplayer Unlocked
description: Restores functional multiplayer for Minecraft Alpha 1.0.5 through 1.0.14. This mod re-enables the multiplayer menu and bypasses the legacy invite-only "secret code" system, allowing direct connection to servers supporting the protocol of these versions.
body:
## Overview
This mod restores and fixes the hidden multiplayer functionality for Minecraft Alpha versions 1.0.5 through 1.0.14. During this era of development, multiplayer was often disabled or locked behind "invite codes." This patch re-enables the Multiplayer button and allows you to connect to any server using a standard IP address.

## Features
* **Multiplayer Unlocked:** Re-enables the Multiplayer button on the main menu.
* **Invite Bypass:** Removes the requirement for a secret invite code; simply type your IP and connect.
* **IP Saving:** Your last entered server address is now saved to your options file for easier access.

## Installation

### Prism Launcher (Recommended)
1. Select your Alpha instance and click **Edit**.
2. Navigate to the **Version** tab on the instance menu.
3. Click **Add to Minecraft.jar** on the right sidebar.
4. Select the `.zip` file you downloaded for your specific version.

### Manual
1. Locate your version's `.jar` file.
2. Open the `.jar` with 7-Zip or WinRAR.
3. Drag and drop the `.class` files from this mod into the JAR.

## Requirements
To actually play, you must connect to a server running [compatible Alpha server software](https://github.com/craftycodie/Minecraft-Early-Alpha-Server-Software).
